content: Retail crypto bot incumbents 2026: Cryptohopper (free Pioneer; $24.16/57.50/107.50 per mo annual) ships bots, strategy marketplace, copy trading, paper trading, AI strategy tools, trailing orders, DCA. 3Commas (free; $16-94/mo annual) is a multi-exchange automation workspace: DCA bots, grid bots, signal trading, manual tools. Kryll: drag-and-drop blocks, pay-per-execution in KRL tokens (~0.1-1% of volume). Category norm: preset bot templates + marketplace + copy trading; validation rigor is essentially absent.
